description: R06-B Interactivity Win32 reconciliation hardened by H07. The COM/WRL provider boundary remains native, while five endpoint/block-range contracts whose complete observable is implemented in UiaTextRangeBase deterministic state now have direct Rust owners and Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: The Microsoft observable is exactly endpoint equality/non-equality. Rust owns the same normalized range state and degeneracy predicate without reproducing COM construction plumbing.
The Microsoft method only asserts equality of start/end endpoint pairs before and after changing one endpoint; the Rust core reproduces that complete observable.
Rust reproduces the Microsoft row-major endpoint distance contract, including the same start/start, end/end and signed two-cell comparison vectors.
All Microsoft endpoint-copy, self-collapse and crossing-collapse vectors are reproduced against the real Rust range owner.
Rust defaults block-range state to false and preserves both false and true values across copy/clone state exactly as the regression contract requires.

sourceRules.notes: The remaining 14 methods still materially exercise richer Windows UI Automation behavior: COM/WRL interfaces, TextUnit movement coupled to native TextBuffer word/glyph/document-end semantics, VARIANT/BSTR attributes, provider scrolling/window state, or generated UIA movement data. H07 does not create portable shadows for those retained boundaries.
